title: Genes differentially expressed in T1D beta cell islets (Elgamal et al. 2023)
bodyHtml:
This table displays results from the study:

An integrated map of cell type-specific gene expression in pancreatic islets.
Elgamal RM et al.
Diabetes. 2023 Nov 1;72(11):1719-1728. doi: 10.2337/db23-0130.
PMID: 37582230

The genes listed below are those found in this study to be differentially expressed in beta cells of pancreatic islets from individuals with type 1 diabetes, relative to samples from individuals without diabetes.

View results from this study in the Common Metabolic Diseases Genome Atlas, or find more visualization and analysis tools for these results at isletgenomics.org.

This analysis was performed using data downloaded from PANC-DB, the data portal of the Human Pancreas Analysis Program (Patil AR et al, 2023; Shapira SN et al, 2022; Fasolino M, Schwartz DW et al, 2022; Kaestner KH et al, 2019).
